notes:
- Bring your own ComfyUI workflows. Export one from ComfyUI with Workflow >
  Export (API), or use a picture ComfyUI saved, and upload it in the Models &
  LoRAs panel. It then appears under Your workflows in the Architecture list.
- The studio finds the workflow's prompt, negative prompt, seed, size and Load
  Image by itself and fills them in for every image. Type {{prompt}} (or
  {{negative}}, {{seed}}, {{width}}, {{height}}, {{image}}) into a field to
  choose the spot yourself.
- Works in Text to Image and Image to Image. Everything else - sampler, steps,
  LoRAs, upscaling - comes from the workflow. See the manual for details.
